name: llm-wiki-dogfood
description: VS Code-first dogfood shell over the architecture-neutral LLM Wiki core.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: LLM Wiki invokes a local Python core and can send retrieved evidence to Copilot only after explicit consent. Trust the workspace before using it.

commands.title: LLM Wiki: New Human Knowledge Note
LLM Wiki: Ingest Active File as Authoritative Update
LLM Wiki: Global Search Current Evidence Across Topics
LLM Wiki: Change Source Over Time
LLM Wiki: Experimental — Discover Copilot Models (Zero Generation)

languageModelTools.name: llmWiki_searchMemory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches the current local LLM Wiki across topics and returns a small read-only set of provenance-preserving evidence candidates. Use this when prior project knowledge, decisions, evidence, rationale, or history may help answer the user's current request. The tool never writes Wiki state.

query.description: A concise semantic search query for the user's current information need. Do not include secrets that are not already part of the user's request.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of evidence candidates to return, from 1 to 8. Prefer 3-5 unless the task clearly needs more.

languageModelTools.name: llmWiki_rememberSource
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Admits a local workspace file as immutable raw evidence only when the user explicitly asks to remember, save, capture, or add that source to LLM Wiki. Filing reuses the human-selected topic when available; otherwise LLM Wiki uses a deterministic Agent Inbox so the user does not need topic ceremony. This tool does not infer human beliefs and cannot perform correction, change, dispute, supersession, deletion, or model-backed maintenance.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the local workspace file the user explicitly asked to remember. Omit only when the active editor file is unambiguous.

llmWiki.pythonExecutable.description: Python executable used to invoke the architecture-neutral dogfood core.

llmWiki.corePath.description: Optional repository/core root. Empty uses the bundled core in an installed VSIX and the repository core during extension development.

llmWiki.workspaceDirectory.description: Per-workspace local wiki directory. Keep this outside Git commits.

llmWiki.maxAiCredits.description: Per-call Copilot AI-credit guard for explicit Ask Luna commands.

scripts.check: node --check entry.js && node --check extension.js && node --check agent-tools.js && node --check product-helpers.js && node test/product-helpers.js && node test/static.js
scripts.package:vsix: npm run bundle:core && mkdir -p dist && vsce package --out dist/llm-wiki-dogfood.vsix
